title: Exploring Multilingual Concepts of Human Values in Large Language Models: Is Value Alignment Consistent, Transferable and Controllable across Languages?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the cross-lingual consistency and transferability of human value concepts using representation engineering to reveal alignment disparities, representation inconsistencies, and unidirectional transfer patterns between high-resource (e.g., English) and low-resource languages.

Using the StereoSet dataset to extract and recognize fairness concept vectors, assessing the model's ability to distinguish between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical text pairs spanning gender, race, religion, and profession across multiple languages.
